note: Endnotes live in EndnotesPart. Semantics mirror footnote.json. Parent must be a paragraph path (/body/p[N]); use --index N to control position within the paragraph. Run-level parent (/body/p[N]/r[M]) is not accepted -- the endnote reference is inserted as a new run.

referencePrefix.description: Literal inline text placed immediately before the dynamic endnote number in both the body reference and the note body. Add-only; cannot be combined with a custom reference mark.

referenceSuffix.description: Literal inline text placed immediately after the dynamic endnote number in both the body reference and the note body. Add-only; cannot be combined with a custom reference mark.

referenceSuperscript.description: Whether both dynamic endnote-number runs are superscript. False writes an explicit baseline override so the EndnoteReference style cannot reintroduce superscript.

firstLineIndent.description: First-line indentation on the first endnote paragraph.

hangingIndent.description: Hanging indentation on the first endnote paragraph.

spaceBefore.description: Space before the first endnote paragraph.

spaceAfter.description: Space after the first endnote paragraph.

underline.description: Underline formatting on the seeded endnote content run.

strike.description: Single strikethrough on the seeded endnote content run.

highlight.description: Word highlight color on the seeded endnote content run.

direction.description: Reading direction. 'rtl' writes <w:bidi/> on the endnote content paragraph and cascades <w:rtl/> to the paragraph mark.

align.description: Horizontal alignment applied to the endnote content paragraph (<w:jc/>).

font.ea.description: East-Asian font slot (rFonts/eastAsia) — Chinese / Japanese / Korean typefaces.

font.latin.description: Latin font slots (rFonts/ascii + hAnsi) — ASCII / Western text.

bold.cs.description: complex-script bold for the endnote's runs (<w:bCs/>). Required for Arabic / Hebrew bold rendering.

italic.cs.description: complex-script italic (<w:iCs/>) for the endnote's runs.

size.cs.description: complex-script font size (<w:szCs/>) for the endnote's runs.

id.description: OOXML endnote id; source of @endnoteId in stable path /endnote[@endnoteId=N].
